audit_2026_11_04: FRESH AUDIT PASSED (first-hand, 2026-11-04) — the trades half of the Detroit/Wayne re-audit ordered by the 2026-10-31 corrections (see detroit-wayne-mi-building for the full account). Three stability passes returned IDENTICAL figures: 122,190 rows all-time, every row carrying an issued_date, max issued 2026-11-03, trailing-12-month 15,732, Sep 2026 1,650, Oct 2026 2,186 — matching the retraction's verified snapshot (TTM 15,653 with Mechanical 5,282 / Plumbing 5,212 / Electrical 4,384 / Fire Alarm 272 / Elevator 262 / Boiler PV 167 / Generator 74) within ten days of live growth, with the type breakdown summing exactly (Mechanical 5,323 / Plumbing 5,203 / Electrical 4,426 / Fire Alarm 270 / Elevator 269 / Boiler PV 167 / Generator 74 = 15,732). The PLD/DNF non-permit case records from the flapped snapshot do NOT exist on the verified snapshot — every window record is one of the seven permit families above. Identity: 15,732 rows = 15,732 distinct record_id, 0 null; record_id families disjoint from the building register (overlap 0).
coverage_note: Trade permits issued by the City of Detroit (BSEED trades register), combined on the county hub with the city's building register. Detroit only; other Wayne County municipalities publish separately.

dedupe_rule.definition: One published permit = one record_id in BSEED's trades register. The register's grain is one row per issued permit; no collapsing is needed or applied.
dedupe_rule.measurement: Trailing-12-month window (issued_date >= 2025-11-04), measured 2026-11-04 on repeated stability-checked reads: 15,732 rows = 15,732 distinct record_id, 0 null record_id, 0 missing address. The pipeline's in-batch duplicate gate and the (county_id, source_record_id) upsert key guard every future pull.

field_map.address: address, as published (present on 100% of window rows). City is Detroit, the issuing jurisdiction; ZIP is zip_code (missing on 81 of 15,732 window rows).
field_map.application_date: The trades register publishes no application/submitted date — application_date stays NULL by construction (the Philadelphia treatment).
field_map.category: The register publishes no permit class — category stays NULL.
field_map.contractor_rule: The only name carried is contact_business_name — the permit's published business of record (13,279 of 15,732 window permits; NULL where unpublished, never inferred). The register's owner_name (property owners, incl. persons), contact_name (the contact person), and the contact/contractor address fields are excluded from pull_select and never requested from the API at all.
field_map.issue_date: issued_date (ArcGIS DateOnly). The window is defined on it. Every row in the register carries one.
field_map.permit_number: record_id (BSEED's public permit number, e.g. ELE2026-03360).
field_map.permit_type: permit_type, the city's own licensed-trade family naming, read by trades.classify_detroit_trade: Mechanical Permit + Boiler PV Permit -> hvac; Plumbing Permit -> plumbing; Electrical Permit -> electrical, except permits whose work description names solar photovoltaic work -> solar (100 in the window, the Miami treatment); Fire Alarm Permit -> fire-alarm; Elevator Permit -> elevator; Generator Permit -> generator.
field_map.status: The register publishes no status field — it is an issued-permits register, so status is 'issued' by the register's own definition and status_source stays NULL (the Baton Rouge treatment).
field_map.valuation: The trades register publishes NO cost or valuation field at all (full 22-column schema verified 2026-11-04): valuation stays NULL on every trades permit, and the county's published dollar total is the building permits' stated total only (the Fort Worth treatment, disclosed on the hub).

history_range: issued_date 2019-01-02 onward in the source (122,190 rows); we backfill the trailing 12 months only (site rule).
license: Public access via the City of Detroit's ArcGIS organization (open-data integration account); no reuse restriction stated in the item record; attribution: City of Detroit (BSEED)
rate_limit: ArcGIS hosted FeatureServer query, 1,000-row pages (the layer's maxRecordCount) with the adapter's 0.4s pacing plus retries; anonymous public tier served the audit and backfill pulls steadily. Snapshot-flap note as in detroit-wayne-mi-building: audits use repeated passes; gate 4's count-match plus baseline guards every pull.
source_name: City of Detroit — BSEED Trades Permits
terms_status: verified-open-2026-11-04: the ArcGIS item 'Trades Permits' (publisher: City of Detroit BSEED via its open-data integration account topsoil.integration_detroitmi; access public) carries no license text of its own and no restriction on reuse; the service feeds the City of Detroit open-data program; figures are published 'as reported by the City of Detroit' with attribution; no endorsement is implied.
update_cadence: Live register (permits issued 2026-11-03, the day before the audit, are in the feed). Freshness (gate 5) is measured from the layer's own editingInfo.dataLastEditDate under a 96h threshold.
watermark_field: issued_date + record_id — refresh re-pulls by the issued_date watermark and upserts.
